title: 第15章 影帝李长生 动童男婴女婴者死第16章 红衣妖女踏月来 这老头有点意思
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 回到家。
李长生并没有闲着，盘膝坐在院子中央，闭上眼睛。
仔细感觉纸人的情况。
一百多个纸人，散落分布在安置区各个角落，编织成情报网。
每一个纸人都是李长生的眼睛和耳朵。
巷口的风吹草动。
邻居家的窃窃私语。
甚至是几只野猫的打斗。
所有信息源源不断地汇入李长生的脑海。
刚开始大脑有些混乱，难以处理这些信息，但是习惯了一会之后，就没有感到那么难受了。
而且他还可以有选择地屏蔽纸人的感知。
爽啊！
有了这些纸人。
安置区的风吹草动都在我的监控之下了。
获取情报能力大大提升。
李长生很高兴。
就在此时。
位于安置区入口处的纸人，突然传来了一阵剧烈的波动。
嗯？
有人来了？
李长生皱了皱眉，浑身肌肉紧绷。
透过纸人的视角。
看到三道陌生气息出现在安置区。
为首的是谢剑。
谢剑阴沉着脸，手持鬼脸罗盘。
身后跟着胖瘦护法，手中提着长刀，杀气腾腾。
“给我认真点。”
“挨家挨户检查。”
“如果发现魔修，就地格杀。”
谢剑声音冰冷。
那位大人已经给他最后的通牒了。
他必须将这件事办得漂漂亮亮。
否则的话。
死的就是他自己了。
李长生看到这里，心头一凛，有一种不好的预感。
谢剑手持罗盘，挨家挨户检查，一看就是有备而来。
他在庭院内布置了很多屏蔽阵法。
但屏蔽不了筑基巅峰的感知。
此刻。
这些屏蔽阵法，竟然成为他的破绽。
李长生在心里如此想着，动作却一点都不慢，迅速将原本的屏蔽阵法拆去，换成粗陋的警示符。
content_en:
Back home.
Li Changsheng was not idle. He sat cross-legged in the middle of the courtyard and closed his eyes.
Carefully feel the condition of the paper man.
More than a hundred paper figures are scattered in every corner of the resettlement area, forming an intelligence network.
Every paper figure is Li Changsheng’s eyes and ears.
There was a commotion at the entrance of the alley.
Neighbors’ whispers.
Even a fight between a few feral cats.
All information was continuously flowing into Li Changsheng's mind.
At first, the brain was a little confused and had difficulty processing the information, but after getting used to it for a while, it didn't feel so uncomfortable anymore.
And he can selectively block the paper man's perception.
So cool!
With these paper figures.
Everything going on in the resettlement area is under my control.
The ability to obtain intelligence is greatly improved.
Li Changsheng was very happy.
…
Right now.
The paper man located at the entrance of the resettlement area suddenly experienced a violent fluctuation.
Um?
Someone is coming?
Li Changsheng frowned, and his muscles tensed up.
Through the eyes of the paper man.
I saw three strange smells appearing in the resettlement area.
The leader is Xie Jian.
Xie Jian had a gloomy face and held a grimace compass.
Behind him was a fat and thin guardian, holding a long knife in his hand and full of murderous intent.
"Be serious."
"Checking door to door."
"If you find a demon cultivator, kill him on the spot."
Xie Jian's voice was cold.
The lord has given him an ultimatum.
He must do this beautifully.
Otherwise.
He is the one who dies.
…
When Li Changsheng saw this, his heart trembled and he had a bad premonition.
Xie Jian held a compass and went door to door to check, and it seemed that he was well prepared.
He arranged many shielding formations in the courtyard.
But it cannot block the perception of the peak of foundation building.
now.
These shielding formations turned out to be his flaw.
Li Changsheng thought this in his heart, but his movements were not slow at all. He quickly removed the original shielding formation and replaced it with a crude warning symbol.
